items.prompt: Looking straight up from a small child's cot: a round frosted glass ceiling lamp on a short chain, softly glowing, filling most of the view; the edges of a high white ceiling and the rim of the cot just visible.

alt.ru: Взгляд снизу из детской кроватки: над головой круглая матовая лампа на короткой цепочке, по краям высокий белый потолок.
alt.en: Looking up from a child's cot: a round frosted lamp on a short chain overhead, a high white ceiling at the edges.
alt.pt: Olhando para cima a partir de um berço: um candeeiro redondo fosco numa corrente curta, um teto branco alto nas margens.
alt.es: Mirando hacia arriba desde una cuna: una lámpara redonda esmerilada en una cadena corta, un techo blanco y alto en los bordes.

items.prompt: A long Soviet hospital corridor at night: identical round frosted lamps hang in a row down the ceiling into the distance, linoleum floor reflecting them, a gurney parked against the wall.

alt.ru: Длинный больничный коридор ночью: в даль уходит ряд одинаковых круглых ламп, линолеум их отражает, у стены каталка.
alt.en: A long hospital corridor at night: a row of identical round lamps receding, linoleum reflecting them, a gurney by the wall.
alt.pt: Um longo corredor de hospital à noite: uma fila de candeeiros redondos idênticos ao longe, o linóleo a refleti-los, uma maca junto à parede.
alt.es: Un largo pasillo de hospital de noche: una fila de lámparas redondas idénticas a lo lejos, el linóleo reflejándolas, una camilla junto a la pared.
